meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, timeline, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把音频、字幕和画面素材合成视频,预览、批量出片并发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要把素材批量做成带字幕和配音的成片。
copy.tagline_en: Render audio, captions, and visuals into previewable video, in batches, then publish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you assemble raw assets into finished videos with captions and voiceover.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会按 HyperFrames CLI 流程做事：初始化项目、在本地目录里搜现成动画、写合成、跑 lint 与 check 审查、开预览,再按画质档渲染并校验输出文件。渲染前它会先等你确认。
howto.when: 当你要求搭建、审查或渲染 HyperFrames 项目,或排查构建、渲染失败时触发;覆盖本地渲染、HeyGen 云渲染等环境。

howto.what_en: Claude runs the HyperFrames CLI loop: scaffold a project, search the local catalog for ready-made moves, author and lint compositions, run check, open a preview, then render at a chosen quality and verify the output file. It waits for approval before rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to scaffold, audit or render a HyperFrames project, or to diagnose build or render failures. Covers local and hosted rendering, including HeyGen cloud.
